CustomObject.description: One source-based review of a saved Order_Form_Extraction__c version (OrderFormReviewer): a separate model request audits the extraction, product lines, calculated values and Salesforce payload against the governing documents, and deterministic checks run beside it. Shadow mode: it records findings only and never changes extraction values, product lines or human edits. Tied to its exact inputs by Input_Hash__c / Source_Hash__c / Prompt_Version__c; marked stale when they change.
CustomObject.label: Order Form Review
